description: This file defines the UnsupportedParameterException class, a RuntimeException used when invalid parameters are sent in API requests within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: UnsupportedParameterException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass that encapsulates a list of unsupported parameter names indicating invalid input in API requests.

methods.name: UnsupportedParameterException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a list of unsupported parameters.

methods.name: getUnsupportedParameters
methods.description: Accessor method returning the list of unsupported parameters.
